region: United States, USD. Rates differ in other countries and change: open each source before you set prices.

shopify_basic.label: Shopify Payments, Basic plan
shopify_basic.says: Basic: 2.9% + 30 cents online, standard US cards (read 2026-10-20).

shopify_grow.label: Shopify Payments, Grow plan
shopify_grow.says: Grow: 2.7% + 30 cents online, standard US cards (read 2026-10-20).

shopify_advanced.label: Shopify Payments, Advanced plan
shopify_advanced.says: Advanced: 2.5% + 30 cents online, standard US cards (read 2026-10-20).

etsy.label: Etsy with Etsy Payments
etsy.says: $0.20 a listing (renews after a sale or 4 months), a 6.5% transaction fee on the price you show plus shipping, and US payment processing of 3% + $0.25 an order.
etsy.note: Offsite Ads: when a sale comes from an Etsy ad shown off Etsy, Etsy also takes 15% (12% for shops over $10,000 in the past 365 days). Not counted here.

paypal_checkout.label: PayPal Checkout
paypal_checkout.says: PayPal Checkout 3.49% + fixed fee; fixed fee for USD 0.49 (page updated October 1, 2026).

paypal_cards.label: Cards through PayPal
paypal_cards.says: Standard credit and debit card payments 2.99% + fixed fee; 0.49 USD (page updated October 1, 2026).

notes: Shopify charges more for premium and international cards, and adds its own third-party fee (Basic 2%, Grow 1%, Advanced 0.6%) when you take payments through another provider.
Sales tax you collect is left out of every fee here; some fees also apply to tax, so your real fee can be a few cents higher.
Your Shopify or Etsy plan's monthly price is a cost of the shop, not of one sale, so it isn't in the per-sale math.
